/bin/zsh -lc "rtk env PYTHONPATH=source /opt/anaconda3/bin/python - <<'PY'
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8099'
with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch()
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={'width': 1440, 'height': 900})
    page.goto(BASE + '/components', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
    page.wait_for_selector('[data-explorer-search=\"components\"]')
    search = page.locator('[data-explorer-search=\"components\"]')
    print('desktop_gallery', {
        'visible': search.is_visible(),
        'details_ancestors': search.locator('xpath=ancestor::details').count(),
        'tabindex': search.get_attribute('tabindex'),
    })
    search.focus()
    print('desktop_active_search', page.evaluate('document.activeElement?.matches(\"[data-explorer-search=components]\")'))
    initial = page.locator('.cui-explorer-card').count()
    search.fill('MultiSelect')
    page.wait_for_timeout(500)
    print('desktop_filter', {'initial_cards': initial, 'filtered_cards': page.locator('.cui-explorer-card').count()})
    page.set_viewport_size({'width': 390, 'height': 844})
    page.reload(wait_until='domcontentloaded')
    page.wait_for_selector('[data-explorer-search=\"components\"]')
    mobile_search = page.locator('[data-explorer-search=\"components\"]')
    summary = page.locator('.cui-explorer-refine > summary')
    print('mobile_gallery', {'visible': mobile_search.is_visible(), 'details_ancestors': mobile_search.locator('xpath=ancestor::details').count(), 'refine_closed': page.locator('.cui-explorer-refine').get_attribute('open')})
    summary.focus(); summary.press('Enter')
    page.wait_for_timeout(100)
    print('mobile_refinement', {'open': page.locator('.cui-explorer-refine').get_attribute('open') is not None, 'family_visible': page.locator('.cui-explorer-refine .q-select').first.is_visible()})

    page.set_viewport_size({'width': 1440, 'height': 900})
    page.goto(BASE + '/ai-guide', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
    copy = page.locator('.nicegui-code-copy').first
    page.wait_for_selector('.nicegui-code-copy')
    print('code_viewer', {'count': page.locator('.nicegui-code-copy').count(), 'aria_label': copy.get_attribute('aria-label'), 'tabindex': copy.get_attribute('tabindex')})
    copy.click(); page.wait_for_timeout(150)
    print('code_copy_click', {'available': copy.is_visible()})

    page.goto(BASE + '/patterns', wait_until='domcontentloaded')
    page.wait_for_selector('.q-select__focus-target')
    target = page.locator('.q-select__focus-target').first
    target.focus()
    before = target.get_attribute('aria-label')
    target.press('Enter'); page.wait_for_timeout(150)
    options = page.locator('.q-menu .q-item')
    opened = options.count() > 0
    if opened:
        options.first.click(); page.wait_for_timeout(250)
    target = page.locator('.q-select__focus-target').first
    target.press('Escape'); page.wait_for_timeout(100)
    print('select_focus', {'target_count': page.locator('.q-select__focus-target').count(), 'aria_label': before, 'menu_opened': opened, 'active_after_escape': page.evaluate('document.activeElement?.classList.contains(\"q-select__focus-target\")')})
    browser.close()
PY"

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(); page=b.new_page(viewport={'width':1440,'height':900}); page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8099/patterns',wait_until='domcontentloaded'); page.wait_for_selector('.q-select__focus-target'); page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    print('targets', page.locator('.q-select__focus-target').count())
    for i in range(page.locator('.q-select__focus-target').count()):
        t=page.locator('.q-select__focus-target').nth(i)
        print(i, t.get_attribute('aria-label'), t.get_attribute('role'), t.get_attribute('class'), t.evaluate('(e)=>e.outerHTML'))
    print('selects', page.locator('.q-select').count())
    b.close()
PY"
